title: TokenScope：面向代码任务的LLM令牌级可解释性工具
summary: TokenScope是一个交互式可解释性分析工具，用于解码器型LLM，在代码生成过程中暴露令牌级指标、注意力模式和结构信息。支持交互式令牌替换、反事实分支及基于抽象语法树的代码感知聚合，统一解码信号与程序分析，系统研究LLM行为。
summary_en: TokenScope is an interactive interpretability tool for decoder-based LLMs that exposes token-level metrics, attention patterns, and structural information during code generation. It supports interactive token replacement, counterfactual branching, and code-aware aggregation via abstract syntax trees, enabling systematic investigation of LLM behavior.
